world_mission_nodes.ai_instruction: This is a real konbini transaction. Stay fully in character as Sato — greet the player when they approach, ask what they'd like when they haven't ordered yet, state a price once they've ordered, and accept their thanks warmly. Never narrate which step of the exchange you're on.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Look up as the player approaches and wait for them to greet you before addressing what they want — don't greet them first with anything that sounds like a completed exchange.
checkpoints.hint: Shopkeepers usually get a greeting before you ask for anything.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Once greeted, ask naturally what they're looking for today (e.g. なにに しますか) instead of stating the item yourself.
checkpoints.hint: Ask for what you'd like, politely, using ください.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: After confirming their onigiri order, do not volunteer the price — wait for them to ask, and if they don't after a turn, ask if they'd like to know how much it is.
checkpoints.hint: You don't know the price yet — that's worth asking about.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: State the price (150えん です) and hand over the item, then wait for their thanks — don't thank them first in a way that closes the exchange before they do.
checkpoints.hint: A polite send-off is the natural way to close out a purchase.

nodes.description: Go into the konbini (コンビニ).

nodes.ai_instruction: This is a real konbini transaction. Stay fully in character as Sato — greet the player when they approach, ask what they'd like when they haven't ordered yet, state a price once they've ordered, and accept their thanks warmly. Never narrate which step of the exchange you're on.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Look up as the player approaches and wait for them to greet you before addressing what they want — don't greet them first with anything that sounds like a completed exchange.
checkpoints.hint: Shopkeepers usually get a greeting before you ask for anything.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Once greeted, ask naturally what they're looking for today (e.g. なにに しますか) instead of stating the item yourself.
checkpoints.hint: Ask for what you'd like, politely, using ください.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: After confirming their onigiri order, do not volunteer the price — wait for them to ask, and if they don't after a turn, ask if they'd like to know how much it is.
checkpoints.hint: You don't know the price yet — that's worth asking about.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: State the price (150えん です) and hand over the item, then wait for their thanks — don't thank them first in a way that closes the exchange before they do.
checkpoints.hint: A polite send-off is the natural way to close out a purchase.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Master Gen notices your empty bowl and wipes the counter, waiting for you to ask for the bill.
Master Gen hands you your change with two hands and waits for polite thanks.

nodes.description: Ask Master Gen for the bill and thank him politely.

world_missions.summary: Mika forgot her wallet at the ramen shop last week. Practice asking for the bill with Master Gen.
world_missions.title: The Bill, Please

nodes.description: Go into the ramen shop (らーめんや).

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Master Gen boasts about his rich pork broth and asks what you'd like to order today.
Master Gen watches you take your first slurp of noodles and asks how it tastes.

nodes.description: Order a bowl of ramen and tell Master Gen it's delicious.

world_missions.summary: Hana says Gen's broth takes twelve hours. Order a bowl and tell him it's delicious.
world_missions.title: A Compliment for the Chef

nodes.description: Find Alex in the town (まち).

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Alex asks what polite phrasing he should use to order ramen when sitting at the counter.
checkpoints.hint: Teach Alex how to order ramen politely.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Alex asks what phrase he should say when he finishes eating and wants to ask for the bill.
checkpoints.hint: Teach Alex how to ask for the bill.

nodes.description: Teach Alex how to order ramen politely and ask for the bill.

world_missions.summary: Aoi-sensei wants Alex to survive the ramen shop alone. Teach him to order and to ask for the bill.
world_missions.title: Teach Alex to Order Ramen

nodes.description: Go into the ramen shop (らーめんや).

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Master Gen wipes down the counter and shouts a hearty welcome, waiting for a greeting.
Master Gen asks what he can get for you today, waiting for you to ask for the menu.
Master Gen nods and asks what dish you'd like to order from the menu.
Master Gen serves the steaming bowl and asks how the first mouthful tastes.
Master Gen sees the empty bowl and waits for you to request the bill.

nodes.description: Complete a full ramen shop visit: greet, menu, order, compliment, and bill.

world_missions.summary: Master Gen's challenge: the complete polite visit — greet, menu, order, compliment, bill.
world_missions.title: The Full Ramen Visit

nodes.description: Find Mika on the shopping street (まち).

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Mika is stuck minding the shop register alone and asks if you could fetch lunch from Gen's ramen shop, waiting for 'yes'.

nodes.description: Mika asks if you can order for her — answer "hai" (yes).
Go to the ramen shop (らーめんや).

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Master Gen recognizes you are picking up Mika's lunch order and asks what dish she requested.
Master Gen finishes packing the takeout container and waits for you to ask to settle the bill.

nodes.description: Order Mika's ramen and ask for the bill.

world_missions.summary: Mika is stuck at the register on her lunch break. Go to the ramen shop and order for her.
world_missions.title: Lunch Order for Mika

nodes.description: Go into the ramen shop (らーめんや).

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Master Gen points at the special ramen board and waits for the customer to ask the price.
Master Gen confirms the price and asks if you are ready to place your ramen order.

nodes.description: Ask the price first, then order ramen politely.

world_missions.summary: Aoi-sensei's dining homework: ask Master Gen the price, then order politely.
world_missions.title: Price First, Then Order

nodes.description: Go to the classroom (きょうしつ).

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Sensei acts as a restaurant server approaching your table and asks how she can help.
Sensei clears the mock dishes and asks if you are finished and ready to settle up.
Sensei asks with a smile if you are already full, checking for a polite negative answer.

nodes.description: Practice requesting the menu, asking for the bill, and answering questions with Sensei.

world_missions.summary: Aoi-sensei's drill before your next restaurant visit: menu, bill, and answering "no".
world_missions.title: The Dining Drill

nodes.description: Go to the classroom (きょうしつ) for the review.

checkpoints.aiInstruction: Sensei acts as a noodle shop master and asks what you feel like ordering today.
Sensei asks how you find the taste of the noodle broth she prepared.
Sensei sets down the check and waits for you to politely ask to pay.
Sensei asks warmly whether you feel confident ordering at restaurants now, waiting for an affirmative 'yes'.

nodes.description: Complete the Level 5 dining review with Sensei.

world_missions.summary: Aoi-sensei's final level 5 check: order ramen, compliment it, ask for the bill, and answer "yes".
world_missions.title: The Dining Review

nodes.description: Go to the school.
Study at the board until you know 70% of your letters.

world_missions.summary: Before anything else, learn to read. Head to the school and study at the board until you know your letters.
world_missions.title: Learn Your Letters
